messages:
carol: Proposal: add a tiny 'handshake' pill on rollout rows that summarizes auto-fallback state. One-line only, expands to small popover.

dinesh: What's minimal? We need snapshot time, mode, trigger short, sample%, cost delta, audit id (copy).

carol: exactly. popover shows causal chain (metric -> route -> rule), last metric point, and 3 actions: preview, open-runbook, escalate.

audit-bot: snapshot-created id=snap-20260326-09 policy=auto-fallback v4.2 trigger=p95>900ms sample=1% fallback=small-lm cost=+$0.25/1k

tara: RBAC: preview -> role=can_preview; escalate/rollback -> role=operator. Every action returns action_id and is appended to snapshot.audit_actions.

ops-bot: telemetry: fallback_triggered snap=snap-20260326-09 value=950ms pct=1

dinesh: API sketch: GET /rollouts/{id}/snapshots/{snap} -> flat fields (strings); POST /rollouts/{id}/actions {action,comment} -> {action_id}. Store input_ref (sha256 or s3) not raw. TTL 90d, cap 100 snapshots/rollout.

carol: I'll add a micro-mock + audit blob example to the doc and schedule a 15m sync.
